practiceReport.name: Andrew Van Ginkel
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 81% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Van Ginkel's practice reps were limited Wednesday and Thursday while managing a quadriceps injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the Packers. He was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for the veteran edge rusher to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. In Van Ginkel's four outings since the Vikings' Week 6 bye, he has accumulated 14 tackles (eight solo), including 4.5 sacks, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery.

practiceReport.name: T.J. Hockenson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: After sitting out last Sunday against Green Bay and then logging limited practices Wednesday and Thursday, Hockenson is ready to return against San Francisco in a potential playoff preview. His lack of a designation puts Minnesota's top tight end in position to reclaim his usual role in the passing game that now has Kirk Cousins at quarterback. Hockenson is a TE1 for fantasy purposes.

practiceReport.name: Jauan Jennings
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Physical blocker/slot receiver who frequently plays through mid-week Limited tags.
practiceReport.beatComment: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this season.

practiceReport.name: Blake Cashman
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 95% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Cashman will end up missing one game (Week 10 against the Packers) while in the league's concussion protocol, and his return means Ivan Pace will revert to a rotational role at inside linebacker for Sunday's contest. Cashman has accumulated 76 tackles (41 solo), including a career-high-tying 4.5 sacks, seven pass defenses and one fumble recovery across eight regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Jeshaun Jones
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Jones -- who was managing a shoulder injury during Week 11 prep -- was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a contributor on special teams.
